value.name: Miles rehearses suave greeting
value.description: Miles practices a polished, seductive greeting to Marylin while checking his appearance in the mirror.
evidence: Miles runs his fingers through his hair, carefully examining himself in the mirror. Suavely smiling.
MILES Marylin! How nice.
He clears his throat, begins again with lower pitch, suave smile still in place
MILES Marylin! How lovely, uh --
He runs a finger across his teeth, which squeak, then puts back the suave smile
MILES -- Marylin! What a pleasure --

value.name: Miles opens door to unexpected visitors
value.description: When Miles opens the door expecting Marylin, he instead finds Howard with Marylin standing behind him.
evidence: On Miles as he opens the door, suavely smiling.
MILES Marylin, what a pleas -- who the fuck are you?
Facing him in the doorway is a large roughly handsome middle aged man in a business suit. Just behind him is Marylin Rexroth, looking as coolly beautiful as ever.

value.name: Marylin introduces Howard
value.description: Marylin smoothly introduces Howard D. Doyle to Miles and frames the visit politely.
evidence: She smoothly puts in: MARYLIN Miles, how nice of you to see us -- may I introduce Howard D. Doyle of Doyle Oil.

value.name: Howard asserts prior acquaintance
value.description: Howard interrupts Marylin's introduction to claim that he and Miles already know each other through legal representation.
evidence: DOYLE I told you we know each other, baby. Mr. Massey represented my ex-brother- in law. Martin Reiser?
MILES Oh. Right.

value.name: Miles invites them to sit
value.description: Miles recovers from the surprise and invites Howard and Marylin to take a seat.
evidence: Won't you have a seat?

value.name: Howard lets Marylin enter first
value.description: Howard defers to Marylin as she enters the office and sits on the couch.
evidence: DOYLE (To Marylin) After you, Doll.
Marylin glides into the office. Seats herself on the couch.

value.name: Howard sits possessively beside Marylin
value.description: Howard sits next to Marylin and places a proprietary hand on her knee, signaling possessiveness.
evidence: Doyle sits next to her, one proprietary hand on her knee.

value.name: Howard mocks his ex-wife's condition
value.description: Howard casually describes his ex-wife's suicide attempts, hospitalization, and restricted custody arrangement in a cruel, boastful way.
evidence: DOYLE Few suicide attempts, little inpatient stint. Naturally, she misses her kids. Six weekends a year and alternate Yom Kippurs seemed harsh to us but -- hey -- all's fair. Anyhoo, she lives with a "nurse," takes her meds and goes to occupational therapy at a local sheltered workshop.

value.name: Miles reacts with ironic concern
value.description: Miles responds to Howard's story with a skeptical, ironic question about whether the ex-wife is flourishing.
evidence: MILES So she's uh, flourishing?

value.name: Howard displays felt wallet
value.description: Howard produces a felt wallet made by his ex-wife, stuffing it with money to show off her craftwork.
evidence: DOYLE She makes felt wallets. Got one right here.
Doyle pulls out a deranged piece of felt stuffed with money.
